title: Output schema of Tokopedia Scraper
description: Tokopedia Scraper writes one item per product into the default dataset and a run summary into the default key-value store.

products.title: Products
products.description: All scraped Tokopedia products. One dataset item per product, with price, discount, image, and shop fields.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Search terms used, total products scraped, number of pages processed, and completion time.
